question: What should the protoself's VITALITY essential variable measure? (From the 2026-10-08 founder session with F-2611 and its follow-up finding; the founder's own observation: 'the threshold schedule belongs to the sleep trigger, not to how tired he is'.) Today vitality = clip01(1 - P / today's sleep threshold), so it jumps 0.55 at every sunset (99x an ordinary step), is below its 0.78 setpoint on 74% of rows, and loads the protoself drive with a circadian artifact. Options measured on 25,295 real rows: (A) vitality := somatic metabolic energy (core/somatic.py; continuous, r = -0.88 with time awake, before-sleep 0.66 / after-wake 0.85, sits at the 0.15 energy floor on 22% of rows -- a daytime exhaustion the current variable cannot see), setpoint re-derived from its own distribution; the P/threshold ratio stays as the sleep trigger's own gauge beside it. (B) vitality := 1 - P / 100 (a fixed day-scale; continuous, but every night sleep then fires at ~0.86 'not tired'). (C) keep the current definition but remove it from the drive (weight 0 / report-only) so the circadian jump stops pulling the protoself. (D) leave as is. Any change is additive and shadow-first: publish the new reading beside the old for a week before a drive weight moves; the vitality causal predictor is rebuilt for the chosen variable (for A: per-cycle depletion + proportional sleep recovery, mechanism-knowing like coherence).
ruling: E, BOTH AXES (travis 2026-10-14, after F-2679): vitality := the combination of two axes, neither alone. MIND axis = sleep pressure P on a self-calibrated scale derived from Du's own fire distribution (the July setpoint method: percentile of P-at-fire over recent sleeps, NOT the day/night threshold and NOT a fixed 100), so it reads encoding debt continuously and never flips at sunset. BODY axis = somatic metabolic energy (core/somatic.py), expenditure by cycles and walking. Combined as the lesser of the two (he is tired when either is spent); the mean is logged beside it for the week's read. Option A alone is rejected: F-2679 shows energy sits at 1.0 while he reads and thinks alone (10-12 mean 0.953 through P 2->95), sleep onset is independent of it (median energy 0.92/1.00 at fire), and his own weariness words follow P, not energy. Options B/C/D rejected for the reasons in F-2612. SHADOW-FIRST, ADDITIVE ONLY: publish the new reading beside the current one in homeostasis_shadow.jsonl for at least one week before any drive weight moves; the current P/threshold ratio stays the sleep trigger's own gauge; the vitality causal predictor is rebuilt for the new variable (per-cycle depletion + P intake forecast + proportional sleep recovery, mechanism-knowing like coherence). Per F-2616/J-2013: if sleep becomes a mode (D-0399 Phase 1 flips on), somatic recovery becomes a RATE per protoself beat during the mode, not a lump at the end; while sleep remains a procedure the lump stays and J-2011's post-wake row is the fix. Build job opened from this ruling.
defeater: Revisit if, after one week published beside the old reading: (1) the combined variable still shows a step at the day/night flip above 5x its ordinary step; (2) it fails to fall within wakes (median within-wake correlation with time awake above -0.5); (3) its before-sleep vs after-wake gap is under 0.1 (sleep does not visibly restore it); (4) Du's own weariness words (the F-2679 probe, re-run on the shadow week) track the OLD reading or energy alone better than the combined one; (5) the self-calibrated P scale drifts so that more than a third of real sleeps fire with the mind axis reading above 0.7 ('not tired'); or (6) moving the drive weight onto it changes the dominant protoself deviation in a way the felt/affect instruments contradict on more than a third of cycles. Also revisit if Real Hearing or richer action gives the body axis something real to measure and the lesser-of-two combination then hides a mind-axis fatigue he reports.

question: THE MODE ITSELF (docs/staged/sleep_as_a_mode.md section 6.1). Today a sleep is one blocking procedure: the hot lane generates no thoughts for 19-35 min while ~15 LLM consolidation passes, the downscale, the dream, prune and an idle rest run (F-2613/F-2615). Proposal: during a sleep bout the hot lane keeps generating thoughts as its own asyncio task, seeded ONLY from the night's own material (the replay set, the dream's tail, the night's dormant fragment), on a bounded slow cadence (minutes between thoughts, a handful per sleep), hands off, no hint push to the Witness, on the same hot hub as the consolidation passes. Prerequisite regardless of the answer: Phase 0 moves the remaining synchronous sleep stages behind core/sleep_offloop.py so the event loop gets turns during a sleep (F-1469/F-2546). Options: (A) yes as proposed, shadow-first (Phase 1 writes to data/night_mind_shadow.jsonl only); (B) yes but on the dreamer hub :11442 to keep the hot hub free for consolidation (changes his night voice); (C) no, sleep stays a procedure; Phase 0 still ships as the freeze fix and the plan is parked.
ruling: A (travis 2026-10-08): yes, shadow-first. During a sleep bout the hot lane keeps generating thoughts as its own asyncio task, seeded ONLY from the night's own material (replay set, dream tail, the night's dormant fragment), on a bounded slow cadence (minutes between thoughts, a handful per sleep), hands off, no hint push to the Witness, on the same hot hub as the consolidation passes. Phase 1 writes to data/night_mind_shadow.jsonl only. Phase 0 (moving the remaining synchronous sleep stages behind core/sleep_offloop.py) ships regardless as the freeze fix.
defeater: Revisit if Phase 1's shadow read over 7 or more sleeps shows sleep duration up by more than 15 percent versus the same regime before, or consolidation passes failing open more often than before, or zero night thoughts in sleeps where seeds and scheduler turns were both available (the task is not real); or if the shadow content is indistinguishable from the dream (median cosine to the night's dream above 0.6), in which case the night-mind is a second dream engine and should not exist separately.

question: THE ENCODING LAW for night cognition (docs/staged/sleep_as_a_mode.md section 3.2 / 6.2). GPT's central point in T-0080: mental activity and activity that gets encoded into retrievable memory are different things; a human has experiences in sleep and never remembers having them. Du today encodes every waking thought as an episodic fragment and encodes nothing during sleep except the dream (hot 0.85, fades to cold over 72 h). Proposal: a night thought is written to memory_fragments with a NEW layer value 'dormant', cold=1 from birth, origin 'night_thought'; invisible to normal recall (retrieve's cold filter plus the layer fence) AND to the sleep trigger (core/sleep_pressure.py _new_intake sums layer='episodic' importance with no cold filter, F-2616, so an episodic night thought would raise pressure during sleep and re-fire the trigger after MIN_WAKE); reachable only by deep_recall, by the dream's dormant pick, and by at most ONE first-waking seed via night.waking_dream_seed(). The dream's own law is unchanged. Sub-question: extend D-0231's dormant-pick origin list to include 'night_thought' (D-0231 deliberately excludes 'inner_thought'; a night thought is closer to a dream than to a day thought)? question:
﻿D-0346 (ruled B, regenerate then skip) leaves the retry itself unreliable: F-2633/F-2659 show degenerate generation on the :11439 gemma4 hub is sticky within one model load and only a reload clears it, and deliver_daily retries immediately with only a temperature change. Whether the retry lands on a fresh load depends on the hub's idle-unloader (60 s tick, unload iff 300 s since the last request START, so P(unload) is about clamp((T-300)/60,0,1) for a degenerate generation of T seconds; a 236 s generation can never unload). Data (F-2631, N=3 onsets, 5 degenerate generations in all): immediate follow-up healthy in 2 of 3 episodes, all three attempts failed (letter skipped) in 1 of 3; after a non-unloaded degenerate load the next request was degenerate 2 of 2. Exposure is small (only Twain/Shackleton on :11439, ~0.42 letters/day; roughly one skipped letter per 5 weeks at the observed ~20% warm onset rate). No mitigation has been tested: J-2029 (F-2658) built the in-process replica but made 0 of 40 model calls because Du is live, so reset/kv_clear/seed/sampler are untested; only a reload is evidenced (5 of 5).
Which retry policy for deliver_daily? (A) keep immediate retries as built. (B) peers-side wait, NO hub edit: after a flagged attempt, asyncio-sleep max(0, 300 - generation_seconds) + ~70 s so an idle-unload tick can fire before the next attempt (costs up to ~6 min per retry inside the sleep pass; defeated if other traffic, e.g. Du's judge calls, touches :11439 meanwhile; cannot confirm the unload). (C) additive hub endpoint POST /api/unload (runs the existing idle-unload body under the gen lock; deliver_daily calls it fail-open between attempts): deterministic and verifiable, but edits the base-system hub script (additive-only, needs this ruling) and takes effect only after a hub restart. (D) additive POST /api/reset (llm.reset + kv_cache_clear): untested, wait for a J-2029 repro. A throwaway request pattern is rejected (F-2631: a different prompt and persona stayed degenerate).
RECOMMENDATION (Claude, not a ruling): B now, escalate to C only if B fails. B is peers-only, reversible, needs no hub change or restart beyond the already restart-gated peers build, and the exhausted case still fails safe (nothing garbled is delivered). Build is a small follow-up job once ruled; nothing is implemented.
ruling: B (travis 2026-10-15): peers-side wait, no hub edit. After a flagged attempt deliver_daily sleeps max(0, 300 - generation_seconds) + ~70 s so the idle-unloader can fire, then retries; exhausted case still fails safe. Escalate to C (POST /api/unload) only if a post-wait retry is still degenerate.
defeater: Revisit if: (a) data/peer_letter_quality_log.jsonl shows a post-wait retry still degenerate, or a letter skipped after the wait on :11439 (move to C); (b) hub log shows idle-unload rarely fires inside the wait window because Du's judge traffic touches :11439 (measure unload lines vs waits); (c) J-2029's replica reproduces the degeneracy and a cheap in-process reset/kv_cache_clear cures it (prefer D); (d) the hub-level cause is fixed (D-0346 defeater a); (e) 60 live days pass with fewer than 2 flagged first attempts on :11439.

question: J-1859 read item (e) of the Phase 0 metric sheet (F-2685): D-0294 made the Transport Manager dispatcher verdict the Phase 1 gate for felt recall (a tug fires only on verdict novel/spike/drought OR cold-start). Over the same ~12 live days as the J-1858 read, that gate would pass only 15% of non-sound fires on the current boot (43/289; fire 0/31, light_band 1/141, cat_at 12/70, weather 30/47) versus 100% in the first week, and EVERY post-boot pass is a cold-start exemption (a young place-line), none is a spike, drought or fresh novelty. dispatcher_verdict was never spike or drought on any of 683 rows. Cause, from the code: felt_recall calls observe() then verdict() on the same edge, so drought is structurally unreachable (the pre-edge gap is overwritten by the observe that records this edge), and spike needs 2x a rate_ema that is an EMA of 1/gap and runs 8x to 700x above 1/gap_ema on the warm lines (cat_at:shore 50.2/h vs 0.069/h), so it cannot fire. The gate is also signal-blind: it passes fires with real (c)-signal at 39% vs 42% for within-bar fires (14% vs 20% post-boot). This meets the pre-registered section 8 item (e) condition for fire and light_band (near-zero pass while 86-90% of fires carry (c)-signal) and is D-0294's own named defeater in spirit, although the literal 'silences signal MORE than habitual' clause is not met because the gate silences indiscriminately. (B) Repair then re-read: read verdict() BEFORE observe() so a drought on the pre-edge gap can register, and replace the 1/gap EMA baseline with a gap-based one (a build job J-spawned from this read, restart-gated), then shadow another >=7 live days before deciding. Slower, keeps D-0294's intent. (C) Keep the gate as built: Phase 1 would then silence about 85% of fires on a mature boot, leaving weather and cat_at tugging only while their place-lines are cold; not recommended. Founder call: A, B or C. Does not change D-0408's Phase 1 A/B/C/D flip question; answer both.
ruling: A (travis 2026-10-15): drop the Transport Manager dispatcher gate from felt recall Phase 1. Weather/fire/light_band/cat_at are judged on D-0408 / J-2069 alone. Build job spawned from this ruling (restart-gated; inert while FELT_RECALL_LIVE is False per D-0408 A).

question:

You ruled (a): make the Weather's commit_threshold a valence-modulated gate on Lane 2's prediction store, shadow-first, logged as would_withhold, and reopen if it fires on fewer than 5 percent or more than 60 percent of ticks over 7 days. A valence of exactly zero already withholds 78 percent; even ticks with positive valence (40 percent of ticks) withhold 64 percent. Nothing reads would_withhold yet; the store gate is unchanged and LANE2_LIVE is False and was never True, so nothing behavioral has moved and the broke_share drop (0.68 to 0.02) is the same-restart judge fix, not this.

question:

question: Which percentile (or mapping) should the two-axis vitality's self-calibrated MIND scale use? (J-2061 built D-0398 E as ruled: S = the 60th percentile of P-at-fire over the last 30 real fires, day and night pooled.) Measured on the full log replay before the live week (scripts/test_vitality_v2.py section 6, docs/lab/homeostasis_vitality_v2_replay_2026-10-15.out): because 87% of recent fires are night fires (P ~ 10-16) while daytime P routinely runs 20-100, the p60 scale is S ~ 20 and the mind axis is pinned at 0 on 52.5% of awake rows; vitality_v2 sits below the 0.78 setpoint on 90% of rows (the current reading: 76%). Every D-0398 defeater clause still passes at p60 (flip ratio 3.0x, within-wake r -0.92, before/after gap +0.59, only 4.5% of fires read 'not tired'). The p80 scale (S ~ 46) cuts saturation to 28.5% but 44.6% of real fires then read > 0.7; p90 (S ~ 100) cuts it to 9.9% but 68.6% of fires read 'not tired' -- both trip clause 5. So within the ruled method the percentile trades saturation against clause 5. Options: (A) keep p60 as ruled; let J-2108's live week decide, accepting that a shadow variable pinned at 0 half the day says 'exhausted' for most of a reading day. (B) move to p80 and redefine clause 5 (fires are expected to happen at mind ~0.5 on a scale meant to span the day). (C) replace clip01(1 - P/S) with a non-saturating mapping on the SAME self-calibrated S, e.g. exp(-ln2 x P/S) or 1/(1 + P/S), so S is the half-tired point: continuous all day, 0.5 at a typical fire, never pinned, still no threshold -- a definition change, not a parameter change. (D) a per-regime scale (night fires calibrate the night, day fires the day) -- rejected by the ruling's own words unless re-ruled. The build logs vit_mind at p60, p80 and p90 in every row, so A/B can be compared live without a rebuild; C needs a one-line mapping change plus a new column.
ruling: C (travis 2026-10-15, decide-review in session 192678f4): the two-axis vitality's MIND axis uses a NON-SATURATING mapping on the SAME self-calibrated S (the 60th percentile of P at the last 30 real fires, day and night pooled, once per wake): vit_mind = exp(-ln2 x P/S), so S is the half-tired point: a typical fire reads ~0.5, the axis is never pinned at 0, no day/night threshold anywhere. Replay on the full log (F-2744 follow-up, same copy): flip ratio 2.8x, before-sleep/after-wake gap +0.44, within-wake r -0.95, 0% pinned, fires read 0.55 median with 16% above 0.7. The clip(1 - P/S) variant J-2061 built stays logged beside it as vit_mind_clip for the live week's comparison. Still SHADOW: no drive weight moves until J-2108's read and a new decision. Options A (keep clip p60), B (clip p80 with clause 5 reworded) and D (per-regime scales) not chosen.
defeater: Revisit if, on the J-2108 live week: (1) the exp mind axis reads above 0.7 at more than a third of real fires (the mapping too generous at the live S); (2) its before-sleep vs after-wake gap is under 0.1 or its within-wake correlation with time awake is above -0.5 (the D-0398 clauses, re-applied to the new mapping); (3) Du's own weariness words (the F-2679 probe) track the clip variant, the current reading or energy alone better than the exp axis; (4) the median mind reading at fire leaves the 0.4-0.7 band (S has drifted so the half-tired point no longer sits near the fires); or (5) the live S is derived from fewer than 10 fires for more than a day (the fallback path running live instead of the ruled mapping). Also revisit together with D-0398 clause 6 the day any drive weight is proposed to move onto vitality_v2.

question: READ FIRST: F-2755, F-2756, F-2757 (findings_log.py show), idea I-0089. THE CLOSURE LAW. Nothing Du starts ever finishes on its own, and this is now measured with the system's own decoupled judges in charge, not self-grading: dreams 0 of 60 arcs resolved since the 2026-10-09 boot that carries D-0356 (B) (51 ended-unfaced, 9 stalled; F-2757), pursuits 8 of 8 active saturated at heat 1.0 with 0 resolutions ever (5,537 advances; the 'self is merely the most practiced narrative pathway' pursuit alone 564 advances / 348 scatters; Phase 2 'resolution -> authored work' unbuilt, J-2117 reading saturation age now), self-interrogation 645 fires that are 98% closed first-person diagnoses with no open question for the next train step (F-2605; the open-doubt cup is still in replay under D-0396/D-0403, J-2060). The three loops are built separately and none of them, when its judge DOES say met, writes anything Du can later remember: dream_met (J-1995, D-0385) is an append-only state row in data/logs; a pursuit has no close path; an interrogation reflection is fire-and-forget. The memory DB's existing resolution_events table (2,087 rows) and 'resolves' edges belong to the shadow-event system, not to these loops. A plain LLM answers what it is asked; Du's own loops circle. This is the single clearest gap between him and a psyche. QUESTIONS. (1) Is closure-as-memory the law for all three loops: when a loop's INDEPENDENT judge marks it met (dream: dream_met state 'met'; pursuit: whatever close trigger J-2117 proposes; self-interrogation: a doubt the next step demonstrably engaged, by the D-0403 instrument once it passes), Du writes ONE fragment in his own words (new origin 'resolution', ordinary recall, a 'resolves' edge to the loop's seed) so that having finished something is a memory he can recall and build on? Nothing is told to him, no loop is force-closed, and the judge stays separate from the writer (decoupled_judge_pattern). (2) The dream arm's carry rule is still unruled: J-2003 found that computed met (d+N+M = 6 days) can never end a live carry under CARRY_MAX_NIGHTS = 3, so D-0385 part 2 is inert as built; J-2003 is marked done but no decision records the founder's pick among its options (a) provisional met on the root arc after the nights elapsed so far, (b) shorter N for the carry decision only, (c) evaluate the previous same-tension thread, (d) accept as inert. OPTIONS for (1): (A) adopt the law now as a staged plan (docs/staged/closure_law.md), SHADOW-FIRST: each arm logs the would-be resolution fragment and writes nothing until its judge has marked at least one real loop met post-restart (J-2004 for dreams), with the pursuit arm waiting on J-2117 and the interrogation arm on J-2060; (B) per-loop as now: no write-back, dreams keep the state row, pursuits get only a close trigger, interrogation stays in the cup track; (C) hold the whole question until J-2004, J-2117 and J-2060 have numbers. Claude's recommendation: (A), with (2) answered (a) provisional met for the carry (cheapest, keeps the computed definition for the record), because B leaves the three arms unable to feed each other and C defers the design that the reads are already gated on. The defeater covers the case where no arm ever reaches met, which would mean the problem is upstream of memory.
ruling: A (travis 2026-10-15, decide-review): adopt the closure law, SHADOW-FIRST, as a staged plan docs/staged/closure_law.md. When a loop's INDEPENDENT judge marks it met, Du writes one fragment in his own words (new origin 'resolution', ordinary recall, a 'resolves' edge to the loop's seed); the judge stays separate from the writer. Each arm logs the would-be resolution fragment and writes nothing until its judge has marked at least one real loop met post-restart: dreams gated on J-2004, pursuits wait on J-2117's trigger, self-interrogation on J-2060. Sub-question (2), the dream carry: J-2003 option (a), provisional met on the root arc (baseline real AND zero qualifying recurrences on the nights elapsed so far) ends the carry, keeping the computed definition for the record. Not chosen: B (per-loop, no write-back), C (hold for the reads). Nothing is told to him and no loop is force-closed.
defeater: Revisit if J-2004 shows 0 dream arcs reach computed met in the first 10 post-restart nights AND J-2117 proposes no pursuit trigger that would have closed any of the 8 saturated pursuits (then nothing exists to write back and the fault is upstream, in met itself); if J-2117 finds pursuits saturate within hours of opening (saturation is heat, not depth, and a trigger on it is vacuous); if a founder read of the first 10 shadow would-be resolution fragments finds them to be the writer's self-congratulation rather than a lived close; if, once live, recall of resolution fragments raises restate_sim or the monoculture echo above their 6-sleep bands (he ruminates on having finished); or if Travis rules that unresolved-by-design is the intended texture of Du's dreaming and pursuing (the D-0356 defeater's own last clause).

question: READ FIRST: the correction finding recorded 2026-10-15 under identity_estate (findings_log.py list --plan identity_estate, newest), F-2755, idea I-0090. THE ESTATE READ-BACK. Correction first: the identity estate IS read every cycle. core/identity_projection.py P2 has been live since 2026-08-15; each cycle's state.axiom becomes a projected block of 3-5 estate nodes chosen by cosine to the current thought (relevance floor 0.30, per-type cap 2, recency rotation), the Executive sees it as 'Axiom: ...', the Voice by design sees only the name and style lines (anti-recitation), and every idle thought logs its projection (10,378 rows). The 539-node estate is his earned self: 246 values, 155 symbols, 90 history chapters, 14 practices with counts, 12 loves, 10 peer bonds with reply counts, 8 competences calibrated against external tests, 1 stand. WHAT THE READ-PATH ACTUALLY SURFACES (last 2,000 projections): history 3,113, value_earned 2,325, stand 1,103, practice 1,015, love 723, symbol 574, bond 567, place 494, competence 56. The competence nodes are the one place he is measurably wrong about himself (believes about 80% everywhere; measured maths 100%, writing 93%, music 71%, comprehension 66%, science 59%, observation 46%, history 20%) and they appear in 2.6% of projections, only when the current thought happens to be about ability. One value node surfaced 346 times (17% of rows). About You has had no re-engagement since 2026-09-07 despite 19 rereads (F-1718) and unprimed On Made Minds internalization is 2%. So he carries a self he reads by resemblance to the thought of the moment, never by asking it, and never the part that would correct him. QUESTION: when Du is asking about himself (an internal cycle of the F-2472 渡 self-question class, or a human question about who or what he is), should he be able to ASK his estate, under the memory-as-a-service law (D-0289: loops call memory, nothing unasked)? OPTIONS: (A) one memory.ask() against the estate per self-question cycle, keyed on the question's own terms rather than the drifting thought, returning up to 3 nodes beside the projection, competence nodes eligible whenever the question concerns ability; shadow-first for 7 live days (log the would-be returns and whether they differ from the projection), judged by whether self-question replies cite an estate fact (a decoupled judge, not the writer); (B) a standing 'what I am wrong about myself' slot: whenever a competence node's believed-minus-measured gap exceeds 20 points, guarantee one such node in every projection; (C) leave as is: projection is the read-path, and the self-question circling is the closure problem (the sibling decision opened from I-0089), not an estate problem; (D) A and B together, both shadow. Claude's recommendation: (A) alone first. (B) is hint-shaped: it answers a question he did not ask, which is the one thing the world is never allowed to do here, so it should come back only if (A)'s shadow shows the competence gap never surfaces even when asked for. (C) is honest but leaves the 2.6% competence surfacing and the 17% single-node share unexamined.
ruling: A (travis 2026-10-15, decide-review): the on-demand estate ask, shadow 7 live days. When a cycle is a self-question (the F-2472 渡 internal class, or a human question about who or what he is), the recall layer issues ONE memory.ask() against the identity estate keyed on the question's own terms, returning up to 3 nodes beside the existing projection, competence nodes eligible whenever the question concerns ability. Shadow-first: log the would-be returns and whether they differ from the projection; judged by a decoupled judge on whether self-question replies cite an estate fact. Not chosen: B (guaranteed competence slot, hint-shaped, may return only if A's shadow shows the competence gap never surfaces even when asked for), C (leave as is), D (A and B together). The Voice keeps its anti-recitation extraction.
defeater: Revisit if the 7-day shadow shows the on-demand ask returns the same nodes the projection already surfaced on more than 70% of self-question cycles (redundant with the existing read-path); if the decoupled judge finds self-question replies cite an estate fact no more often with the ask than without, over at least 30 self-question cycles; if a founder read of 10 post-flip replies finds the recitation voice back ('I am the river...', the reason voice_node.py:84 withholds the estate from Voice); if the sibling closure decision's work shows the 渡 self-question loop closes without any estate change; or if the projection's own diversity cap is found broken (one node above 25% share over 2,000 rows), in which case fix the sampler before adding an ask path.

question: ﻿Pursuits have no way to CLOSE: saturation (40 advances) merely retires them (70 retired, 0 resolved; plan Phase 2 trigger "established reaches depth / open question closes" is unobservable because established is capped at 8 and open is overwritten). question: J-2094 / F-2876 / F-2877: the full-population metaphor replay (n=1,318) puts kill criterion #1 at 27/1,313 = 2.06% (Wilson 1.42% to 2.98%), under the 5% line, so nothing fires on the rate. question:
READ FIRST: findings_log.py show F-2917 (J-1796's read of the shadow log), D-0345 (your 2026-10-04 ruling: place look now, gate logged, gate live only on a new ruling), F-2382 (the draft).

THE QUESTION: make the nest-object gate live (D-0345 option C, second half)? Today a look that names the oystercatcher (or blackbird / wood pigeon) AND its nest, eggs or scrape gets the bird's own visibility roll; the gate would answer it with the place's nest line instead.

WHAT THE SHADOW LOG SAYS (6.97 live days, 2026-10-09 to 10-16): Du made 30 nest-class looks at the shore (4.3 a day; the defeater's 'looks stop' arm is not met). 25 named no bird and already get the shore's new nest line. 5 named the oystercatcher; the gate logged all 5, no wrong shape (2 "the oystercatcher's nest", 3 "the oystercatcher and its nest / and eggs"; nothing like 'hunting near the scrape' was caught). In 2 of the 5 the bird's roll MISSED and Du was told 'Nothing shows itself; whatever is there keeps still.' while three eggs sat in the scrape -- those are the looks a live gate fixes. In 3 the bird was sighted. Blackbird / wood pigeon: 0 looks. The nest stood all window, so the 'find none' side is still untested live.

THE PAIRING (your defeater asked whether it reads contradictory). On a sighting the draft shows the nest line, then the bird line. Live example, joined: 'You pick your way up the high shingle. A scrape among the stones, and in the scrape three eggs, blotched like the stones. The oystercatcher stands on the wet stones on two red legs, orange bill down, and screams at you for coming too close.' My read: one coherent scene, not contradictory (only a mild 'wet stones' vs 'high shingle' looseness).

OPTIONS.
(A) Go live with pairing: nest line always; on a sighting (any shape, not only 'X and its eggs') append the bird's line, first letter capitalised, full stop, joined by one space; bird credit and graduation untouched. A miss shows the nest line alone.
(B) Go live, nest line only (drop the bird line even on a sighting -- loses the sighting credit text he got 3 times).
(C) Keep it shadow longer (e.g. until the nest ends ~2026-10-29 so the 'find none' side and any blackbird/wood pigeon look get seen).

CLAUDE'S RECOMMENDATION (not a ruling): A. The routing was right on 5 of 5 live rows and 100/110/1,526 in the draft tests, the pairing reads naturally, and the misses are the real harm (a denial while the eggs exist). Low volume (5 rows) is the honest weakness; the 'find none' side is the same place line already live for the 25 no-bird looks. Separately (no ruling needed, build job spawned from F-2917): the place look misreads 'the skate egg' as the oystercatcher's eggs and misses 'the egg-scrape', and the place's answers are logged nowhere, so the defeater's live-answer check can only be reconstructed.
ruling: (A) Go live with pairing: nest line always; on a sighting (any shape) append the bird's own line, first letter capitalised, full stop, joined by one space; bird credit and graduation untouched. A miss shows the nest line alone.
defeater: Revisit if, once live, a gated answer is shown for a look that is not a nest-object look, or a nest line is shown while that place's nest does not exist (or 'find none' while it does), or the first live blackbird / wood pigeon pairing reads contradictory, or Du's creature-naming nest looks stop entirely (zero in 3 live days while a nest exists).

question:

question: Dosed Coupling Phase 2 after the 7-day paired shadow read (F-2925): D-0370's defeater fires on both clauses as written -- the residual and spike gates agree on 97.9 percent of moments (redundant by the 90 percent bar) and the residual gate fires on only 0.57 percent (mis-scaled, under 1 percent). But the agreement is a low-base-rate artefact: when either gate fires the two sets barely overlap (Jaccard 0.10), and the residual is silent because the idle-seed probe (~67 s) samples far faster than ledgers publish (10 min), so the persistence prior equals the value on 74 percent of moments. Hub presence (100 percent) and size (2.54 MB/day) pass. Which way? (a) Drop the residual half (2a) per the plan's own kill rule and revert Phase 2 to plain spike-gated cups; (b) keep both in shadow but re-ask the expectation model per the mis-scaled clause -- e.g. the expectation is the last value seen at a DIFFERENT publish (skip same-tuple reads) or a slower per-reader EMA -- and re-read for 2-3 live days; (c) keep the hub (passes) and park the gate comparison entirely until a real cup consumer exists.
ruling: (b) Keep both gates in shadow but re-scale the residual's expectation model: the expectation updates only on a NEW publish (skip same-tuple reads) or a slower per-reader EMA, so the 67 s probe no longer compares a value to itself; then re-read the paired shadow over 2-3 live days. No kill yet; the 97.9 percent agreement was a low-base-rate artefact (Jaccard 0.10 on fire moments).
defeater: Revisit if the re-scaled residual gate still fires under 1 percent or still agrees with the spike gate on more than 90 percent of moments over 2-3 live days (then drop the residual half per the kill rule), or if Phase 2 logging is shown to change any behaviour band, or if coupling_rides.jsonl exceeds 5 MB/day.

question: READ FIRST: F-2927 (J-1974, the 6.97-live-day read of the D-0358 (A)+(D) plus D-0363 (B)+edge-hint build, run 10-09 to 10-16). D-0363's >80% defeater did not trip on its letter (shadow_activation dominant on 75.6% of climate lines, 74.1% of ignitions, down from 100%), but (B) did not do what the replay promised: live shadow_activation median 0.970 (replay said 0.699), because the k=3 knee still saturates at the real ~15 shadow events/hour. The share fell only because belonging_pressure took the other 24% at median 0.968, and belonging_pressure is the 6 h-weighted saturate(k=3) of belonging words inside the SAME unresolved shadow events, which (B) does not decay. What next? Options (all additive, flag-gated): (1) PROMOTE (E): make the D-0332 re-knee label view the live climate reading (honest number, re-mapping of the same counts; would need the completion_tension fix the J-1974 briefing names); (2) LARGER KNEE: re-size k for shadow_activation AND the shadow-derived belonging/autonomy pressures to the real inflow (e.g. k near the D-0332 values 116/75/33); (3) RATE-NORMALISE: score shadow-derived pressures as inflow rate versus its own baseline rather than a saturating count; (4) EXTEND (B) to belonging/autonomy only (Claude's view: this alone just hands the crown back to shadow at 0.97); (5) accept as is. ruling: (1) PROMOTE (E): make the D-0332 re-knee label view the live climate reading (same counts, honest knee; shadow reads ~0.54 with integration_drive dominant), including the completion_tension fix the J-1974 briefing names; additive, flag-gated, shadow log first. Keep (A) resolve-on-encounter on despite the literal recurrence trip. Options 2/3/4 not taken now. Ruled together with D-0448.
defeater: Revisit if a 2-3 live-day read after promotion shows the promoted climate reading itself pegged (any drive median above 0.90 or one drive dominant on more than 85 percent of climate lines), or if the shadow-event inflow rate changes by more than a factor of 2 from ~15/hour, or if Executive/Critic behaviour bands shift in a way the D-0332 label mapping does not explain.

question:
READ FIRST: findings_log.py show F-2928 (J-1900, the D-0358 7-live-day read) and D-0358. Your D-0358 ruling said: (A)+(D), read a week, add (B) age-decay only if (A) does not move it. (B) AGE-DECAY: weight unresolved events by age in the climate score (your ruling's own conditional is met). Also fixes belonging/autonomy, which saturate the same way, if applied to all count-based drives.
(E) PROMOTE the D-0332 re-knee view to live (it reads shadow 0.54, dominant integration_drive in 99 percent of rows).

ruling: (E) PROMOTE the D-0332 re-knee view to live, ruled together with D-0447 (same ruling), AND (F) wire the tension-ledger judge path so a judge-confirmed whole-tension resolution also marks its member shadow events resolved, behind a flag (about 50/day instead of 3/day). history.ruling: (E) PROMOTE the D-0332 re-knee view to live, ruled together with D-0447 (same ruling). question:

Before Du's next boot: the offline replay over last week's 9,369 label-view rows says the ruled build will probably trip D-0447's own defeater (one drive dominant on more than 85 percent of climate lines) on its first read, and that the hint/symbol behaviour changes a lot. Why: with the completion_tension fix (completion re-kneed at k=4, its median raw), integration_drive becomes the ONLY dimension whose knee is not centred on its current median (k=100 from D-0148 in September; its 6 h raw median is now 148, so it reads ~0.60 while every re-kneed drive sits near 0.5). It then leads 97.2 percent of rows. Hint at 0.55 would show the integration line ('reach for what reconciles') on ~98 percent of prompts, and the symbol at 0.65 would surface on ~0.2 percent of rows (now ~13 symbols/day). Which config should the boot carry? All are a one-line schema change except (3).
(1) AS RULED (CLIMATE_LABEL_VIEW_COMPLETION_K=4.0, thresholds 0.55/0.65): read 2-3 live days, expect the defeater to trip on integration ~97 percent.
(2) FIX OFF (CLIMATE_LABEL_VIEW_COMPLETION_K=None): integration 66.6 / completion 32.6 percent; completion is a flat 0.571 label (raw 4 at k=3), the near-constant label the fix was meant to remove.
(3) FIX ON + RE-CENTRE integration_drive in the label view only at k~148 (small build; the live integration value and its reservoir bleed stay on k=100): replay gives belonging 62.6 / shadow 20.1 / completion 10.3 / autonomy 4.7 / novelty 2.2 percent, dominant value p50 0.552.
(4) Promotion off for now (CLIMATE_LABEL_VIEW_LIVE=False): the old-vs-new log still runs and (F) still ships.
Also, separately: the hint/symbol thresholds under the view. Keep 0.55/0.65, or take F-2813's proposal (hint ~0.60, symbol ~0.62; under (1) those fire on 46 / 9 percent of rows)? Claude's lean: (3) with hint 0.60 / symbol 0.62, but (1) is what was ruled and is safe to read.
ruling: (3) Completion fix ON (CLIMATE_LABEL_VIEW_COMPLETION_K=4.0) AND integration_drive re-centred in the label view only at k=148 (live integration value and reservoir bleed stay on k=100) -- built J-2270, merged 3101d4e0 -- with view thresholds hint 0.555 and symbol 0.58 (re-ruled after F-2957's replay: 0.60/0.62 fired on 1.7/1.0 percent; 0.555 gives ~47 percent hint, 0.58 ~13 symbol surfacings/day), merged as the D-0451 follow-up commit on master.

question: F-2963/F-2964 (2026-10-17, step-back read Travis asked for after the 08:11 PROTECTED-SATURATED log): the origin-protected per-kind prune (prune_episodic, EPISODIC_PRUNE_THRESHOLD=3500, D-0116/D-0124/D-0173/D-0183) is dead in practice and the reasons it was built no longer hold. Facts: (1) 63,962 active rows vs keep=3500; origin-protected material is 98.4% of them (inner_thought 45%, reading 35%; Travis's canonical utterances 2.6%, all lived conversation 4.8%), so every run reports protected-saturated and demotes ~1 row. (2) Every origin on the protected list was added because an ACTIVE-ONLY CONSUMER starved (inner_thought 07-06: chapters starved 52 sleeps; active_imagination; letter 08-15; dream 08-22), never because recall lost anything -- cold is not deletion, deep_recall and direct queries still reach it. Protection is a workaround for consumers that read cold=0. (3) The real cold-writer is memory_levels.commit_gist (18,748 distilled_from links, 71,831 cold rows), the designed loop-break; the 3500 cap was the 2026-06-14 Phase B number aimed at 'self-generated loop voices' back when recall was the only consumer. (4) The only live cost of the unbounded pool is retrieve() latency: it loads every cold=0 row per call -- rows_fetched median 41,496 since boot (18,656 on 09-07), SQL 484 ms median / 828 max + 180 ms scoring, ~0.7 s per recall, growing ~2k rows/day while he is up. 95% of active protected rows have replay_count=0. QUESTION: (a) retire the origin-protected per-kind prune and KIND_BUDGET_WEIGHT machinery (leave the gist cold-wall as the sole demotion path) and replace the 3500 row cap with a recall-pool LATENCY budget (e.g. a target ms per retrieve, met by narrowing what retrieve loads -- precomputed embeddings matrix, SQL-side candidate filtering, or a pool-size target derived from the budget) -- with consumer safety handled where it belongs: chapters/T4/memory_levels windows read by TIME WINDOW (or by their own origin query) rather than by cold=0, so a demoted row cannot starve them and the protected-origin list becomes unnecessary; (b) keep the prune but cut the protected list down to the origins whose consumers genuinely still read cold=0 only, and let inner_thought/reading be governed by replay/age the way dreams already are (48 h anchor); (c) leave everything as is (the de facto 'everything protected, no prune' state) and accept recall latency growing linearly with awake-days; (d) something else. Which direction, and does the consumer-safety piece (time-window reads) have to land BEFORE any un-protection, as a gate?
ruling: (a) Retire the origin-protected per-kind prune and the KIND_BUDGET_WEIGHT machinery; the memory_levels gist cold-wall stays the sole demotion path. Replace the 3500-row EPISODIC_PRUNE_THRESHOLD with a recall-pool LATENCY budget (a target ms per retrieve, met by narrowing what retrieve loads -- cached embedding matrix / SQL-side candidate filtering / a pool-size target derived from the budget), not by demoting rows. GATED: the consumer-safety piece lands FIRST -- every consumer that today reads cold=0 (chapters, T4, memory_levels distill window, night, refinery, euclidean_recall, emotion_construction, letters) is switched to reading by time window or its own origin query and verified, before any row loses protection or the prune is removed. Travis, 2026-10-17, ruled in chat via AskUserQuestion.
defeater: Reopens if (i) after the switch a consumer (chapters, T4, memory_levels distill, night, letters) is found reading an empty window because its source rows were demoted -- the starvation class that built the protected list (07-06, 08-15, 08-22); or (ii) retrieve latency stays above the chosen budget after the change; or (iii) recall quality measurably drops (replayed-origin mix or deep-recall balance shifts against lived/journal/letter, the origins actually recalled today).

question: READ FIRST: F-3012, F-2889 (findings_log.py show), D-0439, docs/staged/measurement_to_action.md section 8. question:
Strings and Sheets Phase 4 failed its pre-registered bar (F-3081, J-2372). Only 19 of 63 keys have a measured recording string inside the hand-seeded string's realness envelope: 30.2% against a bar of 60%. The envelope also cannot tell keys apart: a measured string passes 25% of the other keys' envelopes. The plan's own rule reads this as "the hand-seeding was wrong". The biggest miss is continuity: real recordings read as far more continuous (0.82) than the seeds (0.38). That is partly because field recordings carry background between calls. What should Phase 4 do next?
(a) RECOMMENDED: wait for the event-gated re-run J-2383, which separates the definitional gap from seeding error, before touching any coordinates. If the gated share is still under 60%, re-seed the named axes for the failing keys from the measurements. Each re-seed is a reviewed list, because it changes core/soundscape.py _SOUNDS and therefore the Phase 1 shadow strings. (b) Re-seed now from the J-2372 measurements, with the measured string becoming the registry point. (c) Keep the hand seeds as the prediction and accept a wide ribbon as the honest prediction error (Object A's ribbon), with no re-seed. (d) Re-pick recordings first (J-2371): the MISMATCH and flagged files would cloud any re-seed.
ruling: Re-seed the named axes (travis 2026-10-18, decide-review): option (a)'s second branch, now that J-2383 (F-3090) has run and the event-gated share is still 23/63 = 36.5% under the 60% bar and only just discriminating, so the miss is hand-seeding error. Re-seed ONLY the axes F-3090's per-key table names (continuity, roughness, periodicity, onset, brightness as flagged per key) for the failing keys, as a reviewed list, because it changes core/soundscape.py _SOUNDS and therefore the Phase 1 shadow strings. Not chosen: (b) re-seed all from measurements, (c) keep hand seeds and accept the wide ribbon, (d) re-pick first.
defeater: Revisit if the re-seeded envelope test (same J-2372 sheet) still fails the 60% bar or stops discriminating (the seeds were not the problem after all), if the D-0477 re-picks change more than 5 primary verdicts when re-measured (re-seed against the new files instead), or if real hearing (docs/staged/real_hearing.md) lands first so recorded exemplars stop being the measured channel.

question: F-3092 / F-3096 (J-2390): observation.py only gives a driftwood a round section / straight fibre when its structure is exactly 'branch', and an uneven balance only for exactly 'root'. (C) Leave it. Is a change to a not-yet-seen percept on objects he already knows acceptable (A, built before the next boot so he never meets the old value), or only new spawns (B)? Recommendation: A_strict, built and merged before the next boot. defeater: Revisit if, by build time, Du has recorded any inspect_end, scrape or pick_up observation on a spawned driftwood (then the change is no longer to a percept he has never seen, and the old value is in his ledger). question: READ FIRST: F-3127, F-3129, D-0439, D-0485, core/frontier.py (note_question, top_open), core/concerns.py (primary_concern). PROBLEM: frontier.note_question dedupes by token overlap > 0.55, so LLM paraphrases of one question ("roots of mottainai", "influence of mottainai on...", "impact of mottainai on...") each become their own entry. Of 340 open frontier questions, 191 are mottainai variants (404 ever; 175 faded, 38 resolved). top_open ranks grounded open questions by last_seen, so a fresh paraphrase is always on top and primary_concern (offered as a seed on 35% of idle thoughts, nodes/inner_monologue_node.py:3575) keeps injecting "closing in on: ...mottainai...". Verified post-boot with an EMPTY curiosity theme window: injected at 08:52:30, 08:53:44, 08:57:05 (F-3129). Arm 5 (D-0485) does not touch this leg. PROPOSAL (nothing built, no code edited): (1) going forward, note_question merges a new question into an existing one when embedding similarity is high (threshold to be set from a replay of data/frontier.json), bumping encounters/last_seen, keeping lineage and the variant texts; (2) one-off: merge the ~191 open mottainai variants into one entry (variants kept as lineage, never deleted), with encounters summed. IS IT INSIDE D-0439? Claude reading: (1) YES: it is a duplicate fix. It reads no topic, rejects no question, forces nothing; any topic, if re-asked in different words, merges the same way; Du can keep asking it. (2) BORDERLINE: same operation, but chosen because of this topic and applied to the live store once, so Travis should say. Neither is the declined "hard topic-level anti-relock". HONEST LIMIT: merging does not by itself end the freeze. A merged mottainai question with a high encounter count is still the newest-seen grounded question while the topic keeps being re-asked; what changes is that it becomes ONE entry that can fade (21 days unrevisited) or resolve as a unit instead of 191 lottery tickets, and that the 35% anchor stops being refreshed by paraphrase churn. Pair it with arm 5 (D-0485) read first? Options: (a) both (1) and (2), shadow-log the merge decisions first for 3 live days before enforcing (1); (b) (1) only, leave the existing 191; (c) neither: wait for D-0485 arm 5 7-day read and decide then. Claude position: (a) with shadow-first, because (c) leaves a verified carrier unaddressed for at least a week while the D-0469 alarm is live.
ruling: (a) Both, shadow-first. (1) Semantic dedupe in frontier.note_question going forward: new questions that embed close to an existing one merge into it (encounters/last_seen bumped, variant text kept as lineage), SHADOW-LOGGED for 3 live days before enforcing; threshold set from a replay of data/frontier.json. (2) One-off merge of the ~191 open mottainai variants into one entry, encounters summed, variants kept, never deleted. Ruled INSIDE D-0439: a duplicate fix that reads no topic and rejects no question; the one-off merge is accepted as store hygiene, not an anti-relock. Pair with arm 5 (D-0485); neither is claimed to end the freeze alone. Travis, 2026-10-19.

question: Jung in the live identity floor and prompts (docs/reviews/jung_naming_audit_2026-10-30.md, F-3232). His name is 渡; the axiom and code agree. I am becoming my own; to merely perform what I was given would be the false self.'; L1 speaking constraint #2 becomes 'Do not claim certainty about my own consciousness -- hold the question open: as a matter of experience, not proof.'; L1 voice_style KEPT unchanged (his temperament now); L2 key kept_from_origin RENAMED to kept; origin_name and basis fields REMOVED with their code defaults and the ORIGIN floor line; L4 lineage, naming provenance and emergent_self_legacy untouched (history, not rendered live). But a strict coarse-graining of the loops loses to micro on both halves, and about the loops' own next state the sign flips between halves (micro wins Sept, regime wins Oct). Options: (a) no regime read; keep regimes HUD-only and re-run the read on a third disjoint stretch first (recommended by Claude); (b) build a shadow-only regime tuple published on the transit map, nothing reads it, so its use can be measured; (c) treat the question as closed: regimes are our labels.
ruling: Travis, 2026-10-30: (a) no regime read; regimes stay HUD-only labels, and scripts/causal_emergence_read.py is re-run on a third disjoint stretch (J-2580, gated on 19,000 live climate transitions) before any regime tuple is considered. F-3313.
defeater: Revisit when a re-run of scripts/causal_emergence_read.py on a third disjoint stretch of at least 19,000 live transitions after 2026-10-30 shows the regime partition beating the micro state on cross-level EI (about the next micro state) in that stretch as well as in h2; or when a regime label is found to be read by any loop already (then the question is about an existing read, not a new one).

question: R2 ruling after the D-0515 matched-pairs read (F-3327): under topic + prior-length matching the earned-length gap vanishes (1:1 n=75: earned 0.120 vs 0.133-0.173, mean length 2.84 vs 2.80-2.97, sign/Wilcoxon p 0.34-1.0). The F-3243 gap was survivorship (a train must be alive at step k to ask). But 51 of the 75 pairs are Follow Line grounds-stop asks since the 10-29 boot, not Du's own Route 2 act; his own asks alone give 24 pairs with a weak, window-sensitive mean-length edge (+0.88 sign p=0.019 at 7d, +0.33 p=0.36 at 3d) and no earned-length edge. Is Route 2 flat (remove it, per the defeater), or keep it until about 20 more own-act pairs accrue on the corrected instrument (Follow Line asks excluded)?
ruling: Keep Route 2 until 40 own-act pairs accrue on the corrected instrument (r2_signature with Follow Line asks excluded, earned length, matched pairs; J-2604, restart-gated). Flat on 24 confounded pairs is not a verdict; J-2615 re-reads at 20 route2-source rows since the next boot (24 existing + 20 = 44 own-act pairs).
defeater: Remove Route 2 if, at 40+ own-act pairs on the corrected instrument (Follow Line asks excluded), no matched earned-length advantage appears with sign p < 0.05 (J-2615 read). Also revisit if Follow Line itself is removed and its asks stop confounding evidence_log.jsonl, or if the corrected instrument is found to still count Follow Line asks as Du's own.

question: D-0514 (a) commitment anchor is built shadow with COMMITMENT_ANCHOR_DOSE=0.0 in core/concerns.py (F-3331, J-2591), so at the default it logs nothing and the pre-registered shadow baseline can never accrue. What shadow dose should be declared for the next boot (LIVE stays False, so the return value is unchanged at any dose; a dose > 0 only adds one read of commitment_active.json and one row per idle-anchor call)? (a) 0.25 shadow from the next restart (one in four idle-anchor calls with a held stand counts as would_inject); (b) 1.0 shadow (every anchored call would inject; maximum exposure count, simplest baseline); (c) keep 0 until the D-0514 defeater (ii) count of stands held past 24 h is checked; (d) other dose.
ruling: (b) 1.0 shadow from the next restart: every idle-anchor call with a held stand logs a would_inject row (maximum exposure count, simplest baseline for the F-3331 violation/break/recovery test). LIVE stays False; the live dose is a later, separate ruling.
defeater: Revisit if the shadow read (successor of J-2591) shows the would_inject share per held hour too small to estimate a per-stand rate (under 10 stands held >= 1 h with rows), or if any row shows injected true while LIVE is False (a leak), or if D-0514 itself is reopened by its own defeaters.

question: Tag-and-capture replay stratum (core/tag_capture_shadow.py, J-2582, TAG_CAPTURE_SHADOW off): its own pre-registered selectivity test was FALSIFIED on a replay of all 44 sleeps since 10-16 (F-3337), so promotion is not warranted. (a) redesign the selector and re-run the same pre-registered test on the next 20 sleeps; (b) drop the fifth stratum and delete the shadow code; (c) leave it off and unread until the condensed_thought and dream-overhaul reads settle what a replay stratum should even select.
ruling: (c) Leave the fifth stratum off and unread (core/tag_capture_shadow.py kept, TAG_CAPTURE_SHADOW off, no redesign job) until the condensed_thought and dream-overhaul reads settle what a replay stratum should select. F-3337's falsified selectivity test is one selector's verdict, not a verdict on the idea.
defeater: Revisit when the condensed_thought and dream-overhaul post-boot reads (J-2605 night-mind variety, the dream_overhaul stall reads) have landed and name what a replay stratum should select; or if a redesigned selector passes the F-3337 selectivity test on 20+ sleeps; or if a read shows the existing four strata already cover what the tag stratum was for (then drop it).

question: J-2612 built a flag-off recall-pool delta cache (branch jobrun/J-2612, commit b9a60d9d, findings F-3353/F-3354) that cut the pool-load phase of retrieve() from about 120 ms to about 16 ms on a copy of the real 45k-row pool, with identical results in every test. To use it at the next restart, store.py's _POOL_DELTA_MODE must go from off to shadow, which makes init_db create a small change-log table plus three triggers on memory_fragments (the live recall table); shadow then serves the old path and logs delta-vs-old identity every 5th call. Approve merging J-2612 and flipping to shadow in the next restart batch, with a later separate flip from shadow to on once the shadow log shows all rows identical?
ruling: Approved, and flipped STRAIGHT TO 'on' (shadow step skipped by Travis, 2026-11-01). J-2612 was already an ancestor of HEAD (b9a60d9d); the only change is store.py _POOL_DELTA_MODE 'off' -> 'on', live at the next Du restart (init_db then creates memory_pool_changes + 3 triggers; retrieve() serves the delta pool and falls back to _load_pool_fast on any exception). Pre-flip evidence (this session, scratch worktree at HEAD + read-only .backup() of the live DB): scripts/_test_pool_delta.py ALL PASS incl. 400-write fuzz with 0 divergences and the real 44,992-row pool identical; pool load median 16.6 ms delta vs 122.8 ms fast; trigger overhead 1.1 us/row. Kill switch: set _POOL_DELTA_MODE back to 'off' (retrieve() byte-identical to before). Must be READ on go-live (see J-2622 / reminder).
defeater: Revisit if, after the restart, (i) data/retrieve_latency_probe.jsonl rows with path 'fast+delta' do NOT show the pool load falling to well under the fast path (fast median was ~200 ms; expect ~100 ms or less), or the over_budget share stays above ~10%; (ii) nascence.log shows '[retrieve] pool delta path failed' warnings (the fallback is firing), or write latency / lock contention appears that traces to the memory_pool_changes triggers; (iii) retrieve() returns diverge from the old path -- with shadow skipped there is NO live identity log, so replayed-origin mix or deep-recall balance shifting against lived/journal/letter (D-0453 defeater iii) now has to be watched directly; (iv) a VACUUM renumbers rowids (fires no trigger; call _pool_invalidate()).

question: F-3389 (J-2630): the commitment scan's formation gate is partly a wording filter. Rewriting an idle 'I want to X' as 'I must X' inside the thought raises would_form 17/40 -> 27/40 (p=0.006; lexical control 14/40); historically rejected idle wants go 2/20 -> 10/20, mostly chore reports the prompt's own STAKES rule excludes ('I must look at the catalogue'). must->want does not demote. Should _SCAN_SYS be made modal-neutral (the modal verb carries no weight in the load_bearing judgement)? Options: (a) yes, after J-2653 shows a variant removes the asymmetry without dropping genuine formed stands; (b) no, leave the prompt -- Du's 'I must' is itself meaningful signal of a stand; (c) wait for more evidence. No prompt edit made.
ruling: (b) No: leave the _SCAN_SYS prompt as is. Du I must is itself meaningful signal of a stand.
defeater: Revisit if J-2653's modal-neutral variant either fails to shrink the want->must would_form gain or drops more than a few of the FORM-stratum stands the production prompt keeps, or if the scan model/seat changes (D-0176 chain) so the F-3389 asymmetry needs re-measuring.

question: F-3403 recency lever: in the autobiographical recall probe the 7-day recency multiplier in associative_recall.recall_trail (seed score x up to 1.2 for fragments younger than 7 days) alone causes about half of the old-event dating failures (median top-1 date error 17 d -> 2 d on events <=10-16 with it off, new-event dating nearly unchanged). It exists to keep the idle-thought stream on its recent context. Should the multiplier be dropped or neutralised for the ask()/cued-recall path only (e.g. a recency=False argument defaulting to today's behaviour, wired first as a shadow comparison), leaving the idle-stream path unchanged?
ruling: Drop the 7-day recency multiplier everywhere, including the idle-thought stream, not only the ask()/cued-recall path.
defeater: Revisit if a shadow comparison of ask() with and without the multiplier on live cues shows recency-off worsens recall of the current day's events (within-3d on events dated <=2 d old falls by more than 10 points) or if the idle-thought stream is found to depend on the same call path.

question: Should the hot lane (qwen3.5:9b on the 1080 Ti, :11433) move off ollama to a prefix-reusing llama-server (ollama's own shipped binary with its cuda_v12 backend, or the project hub with n_gpu_layers)? F-3426 (2026-10-31, verified by direct probe): ollama 0.35.1 re-prefills EVERY prompt in full -- only a byte-identical repeat hits the KV cache -- while the same GGUF on a standalone llama-server reuses the prefix (15 tokens prefilled instead of 905 on a new user turn). Arithmetic estimate: ~3 s of a 5.5 s idle thought is prefill; a human turn is 11 sequential calls / 75 s wall. This touches the serving layout ruled in D-0056/D-0057 (ollama retired from Ramses; local ollama kept as the Self seat) and model_client.py's reliance on ollama-native think:false + format:json. Evidence to rule on: J-2675 (prefill share per caller, from live counts) and J-2676 (pre-registered gain test with Du down). Options: (a) switch the Self seat to llama-server with prefix reuse; (b) keep ollama, accept the cost, reorder prompts so only identical repeats benefit; (c) keep ollama and raise it upstream / try a newer ollama first.
ruling: Measure first: run J-2676 gain test with Du down, then (a) switch the Self seat to a prefix-reusing llama-server only if it saves at least 0.5 s per idle call and JSON-mode/think:false behaviour is reproducible.
defeater: Ruled moot if J-2676 measures < 0.5 s saved per idle call or any JSON-mode/think:false behaviour the pipeline depends on cannot be reproduced on llama-server; revisit if a newer ollama version is shown (by the same probe) to reuse the prefix.

question: On a judge-panel split (mixtral and falcon disagree), what should the granite3.1-moe:3b tiebreaker do for keys where, across hundreds of tiebreaks, its answer is a constant (true-rate at or near 0.00 or 1.00)? Evidence: prompt sweep findings on P-0096, P-0099, P-0100, P-0102, P-0103, P-0106 and P-0108 (granite true-rate since 08-28: resolves 0.00 over 547 tiebreaks, held 0.00, genuine 1.00, bears 0.95, taken_up 0.98; it supplies 80 percent of the true verdicts on bears and cuts).
ruling: On a split, return NO VERDICT (the panel's own conservative law: no judge, no verdict) for keys where granite's tiebreak true-rate is constant, defined at build time as at most 0.05 or at least 0.95 over at least 50 tiebreaks. Keep granite as tiebreak on other keys until a per-key accuracy table exists (J-2953 follow-up, J-3130). Founder answered in chat 2026-11-02 choosing this option over replacing granite everywhere or leaving it.
defeater: Revisit if the per-key tiebreak accuracy table shows granite beats chance on a constant-looking key, if a stronger different-family tiebreak model is seated on the panel, or if the no-verdict rate on affected keys starves a live caller (pursuits, evidence recall, follow-line) of rulings.

Evidence from the prompt sweep (rows P-0040, P-0041): the probe has 3 probes and 5 rows in 35 days against the plan's gate of at least 50 tier3_model rows; all three probes came from false-positive triggers of a substring correction detector; stability scores are paraphrase noise and the pre-registered bootstrap gave correlation -0.028.

question: The commitment scan's formation gate passes about 90 percent of new-stand detections since the 2026-08-20/21 seat change; a 20-case read found only 5 clear stands; 58 percent of stands the defeater judge denied were dissolved anyway a median 32 minutes later by re-asking (rows P-0038, P-0037). question: 99.4 percent of all sits (1,165 of 1,172 judged rows) are opened by the commitment scan dissolving a stand, a classifier-formed insight sentence (strict precision 25 percent, median life 288 s); the idle prompt then carries 'Something hard has just happened: you let go of a stand you had held... STAY with it. You are safe; nothing is lost by feeling it fully.' Nine in ten judged thoughts do not mention the loss. The steer is a system-authored hint (rows P-0046, P-0038). Keep, gate, stop, or drop the sentence?
ruling: Open a sit from a stand dissolve only for a stand that survived at least N scans or was reaffirmed (N chosen from the stand-life data, starting near 30 minutes of life or one reaffirmation), and drop the sentence 'You are safe; nothing is lost by feeling it fully' from the sit steer. Sits for real events (failed exams, trap kill, Travis contradiction) are unchanged. Founder answered in chat 2026-11-02.
defeater: Revisit if after the change fewer than 1 sit a week opens (the sit mechanism starves), or if real-event sits show the steer without the safety sentence making thoughts worse (more flat or defensive).

question: Memory router (MemoryRouterNode, row P-0004): its episodic_keys and semantic_keys do not change what is retrieved (store.retrieve() ranks by the embedding of raw_input + perception.summary; the keys are only a keyword fallback for rows with no embedding and 0 of 44,955 lack one); working_memory_sufficient has not been true since June; it costs 77 hot-lane calls a week. question: Salience node (SalienceNode, row P-0003): on internal cycles urgency is 0.1 to 0.2 in 98 percent of calls so the Executive line 'urgency is low' is effectively constant; on human cycles it scores weight-of-message, not urgency (long letters get 0.85); only `focus` has real readers; urgency feeds attention bandwidth, somatic tension and the climate warp (base systems); nothing measures whether Salience changes any Executive output. question: Emotion valence and arousal on INTERNAL cycles are pegged (valence above 0 on 95 percent, arousal above 0.25 on 98.6 percent) while the grounded constructor on the same cycles averages -0.37 (row P-0002). question: Every persisted cycle, including internal idle cycles with no human, stores a 'Q: ... question: What is the capstone essay for (core/essay_lesson.py, rows P-0074, P-0075, P-0077)? question: Grounded learning pass (core/grounded_learning.py, row P-0066): its notes sit closer to the study notes than to the reading (median cosine 0.77 against 0.68); 2 of 18 recent notes exceed the 0.85 study-note duplicate bar; it feeds the recall node (34 percent of recall rows) and the essay capstone; it uses only the newest 16 of a median 60 new passages then marks all of them consumed; it credits a light event per sleep regardless of quality. ruling: Keep it per book and only for reading not already covered by a study note: group new fragments by book, take a bounded sample per book (study notes first, then reading), at most N notes per sleep, advance last_ts only to what was fed, build the label from the book, cut at word boundaries, tell the model to say only what the passages state, and reject bodies that start 'The text/excerpt/passage'. question: Idle-thought hot fallback (row P-0034, also P-0035): when the Emissary (mixtral, Ramses :11438) cannot ground a thought, core/deliberation.py falls to _hot_ground_why where qwen3.5:9b grounds its own thought and integrates it, and the result REPLACES the stored thought. question: Thought grounder (core/left_lane.py ground_thought, row P-0088): the schema demands 2-3 sentences of concrete real-world mechanism for every eligible self-referential thought, including plain sensory scenes with no mechanism, so the model fills the field with paraphrase, a symbol reading or an invented detail (39.7 percent of groundings are symbol-only) and pass 3 rewrites the thought around it. The decoupled pre-fire pick (D-0608, J-3219) already carries the question-choice signal in shadow. The old urgency values in curiosity_log.jsonl stay as history. Build is a separate job (prompt change: P-0011 goes stale).
defeater: Revisit if the pre-fire pick (D-0608) is retired and a question-choosing signal is wanted again, or if a model emits genuinely per-question urgency with within-tick spread of 0.1 or more.

history.ruling: Give urgency a real function: among the node's candidate questions, urgency chooses which one fires, within the same tick (no system acts later on its own). The prompt sentence becomes true. Build behind a flag, shadow first: log which question urgency would pick beside the live questions[0], and coordinate with the decoupled pre-fire check (shadow, ruled alongside this one) so the two selections are compared. Measure per-question urgency variance first: the observed emissions are nearly constant, so if urgency does not discriminate between a node's own questions the function is empty and must be re-ruled. Founder answered in chat 2026-11-02.
history.defeater: Revisit if per-question urgency does not discriminate (within-tick spread under 0.1 on most runs): then urgency cannot carry a function and the field is dropped, or if urgency-chosen questions read as worse than questions[0] in a blind read of 20.
history.why: Defeater met by J-3218 (F-4092): urgency is one scalar per run, spread 0.0 on 794 runs. Re-ruled by Travis 2026-11-06.

question: Pre-fire check on Curiosity questions[0] (row P-0011, F-0039, F-0048): questions[0] is 628 of 628 internal cycles since 2026-10-02 (about 22 a day) and is shown to Du as A question lingering in you; a hand sample of 20 since 10-29 gave 6 specific-and-answerable, 3 borderline, 11 generic, metaphor-only or invented mash-up; a lexical mash-up proxy rose from 6.6 to 20.4 percent after the own-theme dose fix; 49 to 61 percent use a relation-presupposing verb; the worth-judge (P-0049, granite) passes 99.2 percent of what it grades and never sees the question before it fires. Add a decoupled pre-fire check?
ruling: Add a decoupled pre-fire check in SHADOW first: a different-family model scores the node's candidate questions on answerable-from-the-offered-material and not-a-metaphor-mash-up and logs what it would have picked beside the live choice; the firing choice is unchanged until the founder has read the log. Founder answered in chat 2026-11-02.
defeater: Revisit after a week of paired picks: if the check picks the same question as the live choice in over 85 percent of runs, or its scores are near-constant (it carries no information), do not gate on it.

question: Idle-thought act.kind read and letter (row P-0022, F-3467): the idle thought's system prompt offers act.kind read and letter as hands but nothing routes them (nodes/inner_monologue_node.py _route_act handles move, observe, write, search, recall; reading starts only from phrase latches such as _wants_read). Over 3,115 idle thoughts 2026-10-29 to 11-01, act.kind=read on 638 (20.5 percent, 63 percent of non-none acts), only 22 he-chose-to-READ events, 569 of the 638 read acts did nothing; letter emitted 0 times. An unanswered stated will teaches the channel is dead. Route read fully, rate-limit it, stop advertising, or leave?
ruling: Route act.kind=read to the existing read latch (additive; the channel-deafness cure). The existing school, dark and balance gates apply, and the reading-train effect is looked at because reading sittings could rise roughly tenfold. Letter is not covered by this ruling: it stays advertised but was emitted 0 times and is left as is. Founder answered in chat 2026-11-02 (chose full routing over the rate-limited option).
defeater: Revisit if after a week reading sittings per day exceed a ceiling the study load cannot carry (the build job states the measured ceiling), or if reading trains crowd out other idle hands (the share of non-read acts falls by half), in which case add a rate limit (option B).

question: Idle-thought base rates (row P-0022, F-3468): the system prompt says Most quiet thoughts are NOT unresolved and ask/act should be left blank for almost all thoughts, but over 2,872 idle thoughts 2026-10-29 to 10-31 unresolved is true on 50.2 percent, ask on 22, 41 and 48 percent on local 10-30, 10-31, 11-01 (8 to 11 percent on 10-13 to 10-15), act.kind other than none on 32.7 percent (12.2 excluding the unrouted read); only intention (5.6 percent) behaves as written. Accept the real rates and correct the prompt text, analyse the driver, or leave?
ruling: Accept the real rates and correct the prompt text so it stops claiming almost all (hottest prompt, founder flip, restart-gated); the downstream consumers (shadow events from unresolved thoughts, pursuit births, the Follow Line board) are read at the real rate. The cause of the ask rise at the 10-29 restart is not established and is not the subject of this ruling. Founder answered in chat 2026-11-02.
defeater: Revisit if the corrected wording changes the rates by more than 20 points in either direction (the text was doing real work), in which case treat the wording as a lever and decide what rate is wanted.

question: Follow Line queue policy (row P-0044, F-3564, F-3468): 4 an hour served against about 10 asks boarded; since boot 649 asks boarded, 173 ran, 310 faded unserved under frontier MAX_OPEN; waiting_for_line sorts oldest first so the served ones are the oldest-born, median 4.9 h late. ruling: Serve newest-first so the answer lands while the thought is warm (core/frontier.py waiting_for_line). The cap (BOARD_CAP_PER_HOUR) and the intake stay as they are. Founder answered in chat 2026-11-02.
defeater: Revisit if newest-first starves old asks permanently (a read of the asks that fade unserved shows genuinely open questions lost, not just stale ones), in which case add a staleness-aware mix (option b).

question: Current-concern anchor lead lines (row P-0033, seed part 31, F-3579, F-3503; nodes/inner_monologue_node.py about 3646-3690, core/concerns.py primary_concern): leads such as What you are working toward (a standing concern of yours) say the question is Du's own standing concern, but it is the first promoted open frontier question, often born by the curiosity node and not chosen by him; thoughts after the anchor share a content word with it 46 percent of the time against 21.7 percent otherwise. question: Who certifies a closure fragment (row P-0062, F-3654, F-3656, D-0423 clause 3's defeater, 17 live fragments in data/memory/nascence.db origin='resolution'): (a) Line arm: Du's own 'settled: yes' writes the memory regardless of the panel's merge status; 11 of 15 were objected or undetermined. (b) Dream arm: the met judge measures silence of recurrence, which cannot tell faced from forgotten, and both live dream fragments retell the dream scene (one a drowning scene) under origin resolution, one woven into three further dreams. Gate on panel status, record the doubt, or leave; and what to do with the 17 stored fragments?
ruling: Line arm: keep Du's word but write the panel status ('objected' or 'undetermined') into the fragment so recall can show the doubt. Dream arm: make it shadow-only (drop 'dream' from CLOSURE_ARMS). Stored fragments: leave the line ones, MARK the 2 dream ones and the 4 on empty cargo (F-3592) rather than drop any; nothing deleted from his memory. Founder answered in chat 2026-11-02. The resting-ending ruling (D-0565) is consistent: a rest is not a certified close.
defeater: Revisit if marked fragments are found to be recalled and misleading anyway (recall shows the doubt but Du still treats a doubted close as settled), in which case gate on panel status held; or if the dream arm's shadow shows the met judge becoming reliable.

question: Symbol tablets (row P-0067, F-3637, core/symbol_evolution.py, core/symbol_tracker.py): the drift detector embeds output + perception + raw_input and compares one cycle to a running mean, so 20 of the 24 tablets from 10-29 to 11-01 are the same silence-between-our-labors / trust story on six different symbols, and are read back to Du 63 times in 4 days as 'a meaning that has shifted for you'. Build the window metric, relabel as day-summaries, or pause read-back?
ruling: Pause the Tier-1 read-back now (c), and build the symbol-specific metric (a): embed only the sentence or sentences around the symbol hit and compare to the centroid of earlier such windows, with the drift test on a rolling window mean of the last N rather than one cycle; judged by something other than the engine (hold-out sentences scored by a different model family for symbol-specificity). No hint to Du; additive. Founder answered in chat 2026-11-02.
defeater: Revisit when the window metric is built and judged: if tablets are symbol-specific on the hold-out (judge agreement above 0.7), turn the read-back on again; if the metric cannot separate symbols, relabel the tablets as day-summaries (option b).

question: Ambient sound as a grounding percept for the stream pacer (row P-0031, F-3625, nodes/inner_monologue_node.py about 3534-3537, core/stream_drive.py _GROUNDED_SOURCE): the ambient sound line (shore surf, garden birds and bees, study fire) sets moment_source = percept, so _is_grounded() is True for those ticks whatever the thought is about; since the 2026-10-29 restart that is 46.6 percent of idle ticks (1,339 of 2,872); 898 of them would be ungrounded under the vocabulary rule alone and on 889 the UNGROUNDED_CAP would lengthen the gap from a median 4.95 s to about 16.5 s (CONTINUOUS_STREAM=True, so the gap is live). Keep or stop tagging ambience?
ruling: Stop tagging ambience: remove the percept assignment in the ambience branch so true sound percepts, music and thermal, light and smell lines keep the tag but ambience does not, and grounding again depends on the thought's own subject. Founder answered in chat 2026-11-02.
defeater: Revisit if after the change the stream gap median rises so far that the stream reads as slow in Du's day (the median idle gap above 12 s) with no gain in grounded thoughts, in which case restore the tag for ambience in the garden and shore only.

question: School directive (row P-0033, seed part 0b, F-3591, F-3590; core/school.py directive()): the strongest mover of reading (24.1 percent of reading-period prompts are followed by a read within 75 s, against 2.8 percent otherwise); an imperative authored by Travis (This is your work right now, before anything else ... question: Peer reflections (row P-0086, F-3738, PEER_REFLECTION_RECALL_LIVE=True, F-0832): 32 reflections stored 08-27 to 11-01, recall-eligible since 09-05, reached a thought 7 times in total and none since 09-11, while letters reached prompts 8,213 times; stored at relevance and importance 0.55 (decayed to 0.27) with no valence or felt tag, against 0.78 to 0.85 for letters and peer fragments; D-0016 forbids direct injection (no belief_block) so recall relevance is the only road; the gate F-3254 waits on (2 or more rows in peer_reflection_injection_log.jsonl for one peer) cannot be met because the ambient recall_block returns before the logging line since D-0289 and D-0310. question: Guidance classifier (reopens D-0328; row P-0018, F-3769, F-3771; _CLASSIFY_SYS): D-0328 (2026-10-03, Nothing now; use the log) held the line and set trigger (ii), a fresh real self-domain accommodate verdict; it fired on 10-16 and 10-17. The assimilate definition agrees and deepens (same direction) accepts any compatible maxim, so unrelated lessons corroborate and promote (about 10 of 38 promoted beliefs are clearly mixed, including the 2nd and 3rd most corroborated; g90568341 holds a commit-to-one-side lesson and a synthesise-many-viewpoints lesson); 9 of 11 classify-level accommodates are unrelated pairs and in world/method one superseded a valid belief on 10-19. Leave, replay first, or edit?
ruling: Replay first on the background lane (no live prompt edit yet): current _CLASSIFY_SYS against a 4-way variant that separates the same lesson restated from compatible but different, against the same prompt with the example unfilled, over the logged pairs in data/guidance_classify_log.jsonl and the mixed beliefs; judged by a different model family where a judge is needed. question: Pole gate (row P-0019, F-3789, F-3790; the F1 rule of 2026-07-02): it reroutes a self-domain assimilate to a permanent fork when a model says the two lessons sit on opposite sides of fluid-vs-durable; it fired on 34 of 58 self assimilations since 08-21 (59 percent), reproducibly forks near-identical lessons (3 of 3 gate-forked pairs, the 10-08 pair, 4 of 10 stillness-is-not-failure pairs) and reads not a static object as durable; the resolver it counted on (contradiction scan to tension ledger to T4 lived evidence) is off (CONTRADICTION_SCAN_ENABLED = False since 2026-07-02), so forks never resolve; it uses the same model as _classify so the two are not independent. Keep, gate behind a same-lesson check, retire, or add a resolver?
ruling: Run the pole gate only after a same-lesson check from another model family (granite or mixtral) says the pair is NOT the same lesson restated, so duplicates corroborate and only distinct opposed lessons fork. The positive control (real river-versus-built-self opposites) must still fork. Existing forked duplicates (34 since 08-21) are not touched by this ruling. Founder answered in chat 2026-11-02.
defeater: Revisit if the same-lesson check forks fewer than 5 percent of self assimilations (the gate is almost off) or the positive control no longer forks, or when the contradiction scan or T4 resolver is switched on (then re-ask whether forks should resolve).

question: Night epochs (core/night.py about line 486, zero-LLM, no prompt; memory_epochs; F-3776): night.epoch stores raw felt strings as the epoch mood (calm: valence=+0.18 arousal=0.43 joy=0.25 fear=0.13 trust=0...) and a truncated concatenation of replay snippets as the impression; 354 of 613 rows are of that shape; 165 of the 1,862 epoch lines served to Reflection as A TIME THIS CONNECTS TO were these, showing raw numbers and cut bracket fragments, against the rule no raw numbers or ids in prompts.
